desc: Iterate through each element `t` in the `target` array.
For each `t`, iterate through every element `n` in the `nums` array.
Calculate the cost to make `n` a multiple of `t` using the formula `(t - n % t) % t`.
Track the minimum cost found for the current `t` across all `n` in `nums`.
Sum the minimum costs for all elements in `target` and return the total.

Implement the brute force approach: Initialize `total_ops = 0`. Loop through each `t` in `target`. Inside, initialize `min_ops = infinity`. Loop through each `n` in `nums`. Calculate `rem = n % t`. If `rem == 0`, `cost = 0`. Else, `cost = t - rem`. Update `min_ops = min(min_ops, cost)`. Add `min_ops` to `total_ops`. Return `total_ops`.
